entities.name: Urwah al-Bariqi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Urwah Ibn Abi Al-Ja"d Al-Bariq (Arabic: عروة البارقي) was a companion of Muhammad. He was a governor of Kufa and was involved in the early Muslim conquests of Persia.
